caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered on a plain, off-white or beige background. The object appears to be a vessel, possibly a vase or pitcher, rendered in muted pencil or graphite tones. The vessel has a narrow neck that flares slightly at the top, with a patterned surface featuring diagonal lines and geometric shapes. On one side, there is a relief or sculpted human face in profile, integrated into the curvature of the vessel, with a prominent nose, lips, and chin. The bottom part of the vessel curls into a tight spiral or volute, with additional linear and curved decorative elements following the contours of the spiral. Near the lower right corner of the drawing, there is handwritten text that reads “full size P. Ward.”
title: Scent Bottle
